purpose: Retain the installed SQL process/thread/memory and latency baseline for later shared-context work, including observed slower candidate timings. No correctness input or timing budget depends on these observations.

conditions.conditions: Shared Linux host with unrelated builds and services active; no CPU affinity/frequency control. Each workload runs after its own build, with no competing proof owned by this task. Control then candidate, no cache eviction. Resource snapshots add work between timed statements.

control.jsonl.transformation: Keep every complete JSON output line byte-for-byte; omit non-JSON build/shell output. No field redaction or reserialization.

candidate.jsonl.transformation: Keep every complete JSON output line byte-for-byte; omit non-JSON build/shell output. No field redaction or reserialization.
